channel.title: Counter Tested guides
channel.description: We publish buyer questions, comparison dimensions and the paperwork behind each recommendation. When we have not confirmed something, the page says so instead of guessing.

item.title: What we did not test, and why that sentence is on every page
item.description: The house rules of this site, written down where readers can hold us to them — including the part where our own five product links are not clickable yet.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Eight functions, one element. The six questions that separate an appliance that replaces three gadgets from one that becomes a fourth.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The appliance you keep is the one that is annoying to wash least. A concrete way to price cleanup time and footprint before you buy, using only what a listing page already tells you.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts, litres, "serves 6", a chicken. What each of those numbers is actually claiming, and the seven-line checklist that replaces a week of reading reviews.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two boxes, two prices, nearly identical marketing copy. Here are the four things that actually change how you cook, and how to check each one on a listing page in about ten minutes.
